name: Pharmco Industries Inc
old_description: Locally owned and operated, Pharmco is a full-service feed, seed, animal health, farming and ranching equipment provider serving the Midwest. When you need expert advice, products, and services that’ll make your operation successful, look to Pharmco.
about:
Pharmco Industries Inc operates from its headquarters in Chamberlain, South Dakota, with additional locations in Platte, Winner, and Kimball. The company is locally owned and operated, though its founding year and founders are not publicly disclosed. It began as a full-service provider of feed, seed, animal health products, and farming and ranching equipment to agricultural operations across the Midwest.

The business distributes a range of agricultural inputs — including feed, seed, and animal health supplies — and supplies farming and ranching equipment from established manufacturers. Its service portfolio covers feed ration formulation, nutrition consulting, livestock management recommendations, alternative feed sourcing, byproduct evaluation, feedlot profitability analysis, cattle record keeping and billing for custom feedlots, and regular visual herd inspections. The company also leverages industry connections to link customers with feedstuffs, cattle brokers, and other market representatives.

Pharmco serves livestock producers, crop farmers, and custom feed yards throughout the Midwest. Its customer base includes cattle feeding operations that rely on the firm’s nutrition expertise, record-keeping services, and market connections to manage herd performance and marketing decisions.

The company emphasizes its local ownership and territory-specific service model, highlighting an experienced team with deep knowledge of the livestock and seed sectors. It positions its differentiators as trusted customer relationships, extensive industry connections, and a commitment to supplying quality products from reputable manufacturers.
